content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post at NII is 22 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post in the National Institute of Immunology (NII) recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) posts is through Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post at NII?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post is Rs. 42,000/- per month consolidated plus 27% HRA. This is a competitive salary for a project-based position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc./M.Tech degree in any area of Life Sciences/Chemical Sciences with NET/GATE qualification and two years of research experience to be eligible.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 100/- for General/OBC candidates. However, SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post at NII primarily involves an Interview, which may be conducted either offline or online, as decided by the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the NII Senior Research Fellow (Project) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Research Fellow (Project) post is in Delhi, specifically at the National Institute of Immunology (NII) campus in Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for NII recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for the National Institute of Immunology (NII) is https://www.nii.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contractual job type. The project tenure is expected to end on 18 March 2027, as per the important dates mentioned.
